description: This file defines the ErrorMessage class in the SuiteCRM namespace, which manages error messages, logging, and exception handling with configurable levels and behavior.

classes.name: ErrorMessage
classes.description: A class for managing error messages, logging, and exceptions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorMessage object with specified message, code, log level, and throw behavior.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the internal state of the ErrorMessage object with provided message, code, level, and throw flag.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Logs the message at the specified log level and throws an exception if configured to do so.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Static method to create an ErrorMessage instance and handle it (log and possibly throw).

methods.name: log
methods.description: Static method to log an error message without throwing an exception.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Static method to log and throw an error message.
